title: Phase 0 Epic 5: Domain Constant Registry
description:
Objective
Create an auditable, deduplicated registry for all domain-separation constants used across identity/coordination/persistence derivations.

Implementation References
- `tmp/gossip-project-artifacts/phase0-outline.md`
- `tmp/gossip-project-artifacts/boundary_1_chunks_1_2.rs`

- `tmp/gossip-project-artifacts/boundary_5_chunk_1.rs`
- `tmp/gossip-project-artifacts/boundary_5_chunk_2.rs`

Scope and Notes
- Consolidate all tags in one module and remove ambiguity/duplication risk.
- Preserve naming conventions and explicit derivation ownership per constant.

Boundary 1 Errata Integration (ERRATUM-001)
- `domain_hasher` must use BLAKE3 derive-key mode, not `Hasher::new()` + `update(domain)`.
- Required form:
  - `Hasher::new_derive_key(core::str::from_utf8(domain).expect("domain tag must be valid UTF-8"))`
- Domain constant type decision remains: keep constants as `&[u8]`, convert to `&str` inside `domain_hasher`.
- `key_secret_hash` behavior is unchanged (BLAKE3 keyed mode with domain tag fed as data).
- `finalize_32` and `finalize_64` behavior is unchanged (output extraction only).
- Any domain-hasher golden vectors must be regenerated after derive-key mode is in use.

Testing Requirements
- Add exhaustive uniqueness test over every published domain constant.
- Include structural domain-separation checks where `derive_key("A", X) != derive_key("B", X)` for identical payloads.

Detail Gaps to Resolve in Child Tasks
- Decide final module location (`identity/domain.rs` vs top-level `domain.rs`) and document rationale.
- Confirm ownership of golden vector refresh after derive-key adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Single-source domain constant module exists, is documented, and uniqueness-tested.
close_reason: All subtasks complete: domain constants audited, unified module built with 13 constants, and uniqueness meta-test added
